subject: Articles 2 and 3 of Draft Charter
overview: The Medford Charter Study Committee reviewed Articles 2 and 3 of the draft city charter, focusing on councilor eligibility, leadership terms, and meeting procedures. The committee voted to retain language allowing ward councilors who relocate within the city to complete their terms, approved annual elections for council leadership, and discussed public participation rules.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes from the March 7, 2024 meeting.

items.title: Councilor Eligibility and Ward Residency
items.summary: Following discussion on potential qualifications regarding criminal history, age, and voter residency, the committee voted to retain draft language allowing a ward councilor who moves elsewhere within Medford during their term to complete that term.

items.title: Election of Council President and Vice President
items.summary: The committee approved a motion amending the draft charter to have the City Council elect its president and vice president annually, permitting consecutive terms.

items.title: Council Powers, Prohibitions, and Member Conduct
items.summary: Members discussed councilor absenteeism, decorum, and prohibitions on interfering in municipal administration, with consultants clarifying that attendance and meeting decorum are typically governed by internal council rules and recall provisions.

items.title: Meeting Schedules and Public Participation
items.summary: Members debated whether to define meeting schedules and citizen speaking times in the charter, deciding to defer the question of forming a public participation subcommittee to the next agenda.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Public participation was opened, and no members of the public spoke.
